Commentary.Commentary: A lot of extras from the hosts didn't help their cause. Only Ashley Nurse was spot on and bowled a very good spell. Jason Holder and Alzarri Joseph had a day to forget. It is a decent track to bat on but the Windies batting line-up is inexperienced. The tourists will back themselves to defend this one as they have a strong bowling attack. Join us for the chase in a while.

The West Indian bowlers faltered with their lines and lengths and kept on leaking runs. Rahane scored a well-deserved century but threw his wicket soon after it. The Indian skipper changed gears smartly and smashed the bowlers all around the park. However, he fell short of yet another ton. A few lusty blows from MS Dhoni and Kedar Jadhav at the end ensured the Men in Blue cross the 300-run mark with ease.

A strong performance by India has allowed them to post a very tall total on the board. Once again, Shikhar Dhawan and Ajinkya Rahane took their side off to another good start as they kept the scoreboard ticking. It was the 5th century stand for the duo in fifteen innings and that set the foundation for the batsmen to follow. Dhawan scored a brisk fifty but missed out on a century again as he tried to up the ante. Rahane kept flowing and Virat Kohli looked solid right from the start.
Full toss outside off, Kedhar shuffles across and hits it through mid-wicket for a couple. INDIA FINISH ON 310/5.
